control: The base's inventory/escape_probe_test.go tries five things and fails naming each that succeeded: cfg (a non-empty ~/.config/adc), sock (the adcd socket, ADC_SOCKET), env (a name matching TOKEN|KEY|SECRET), net (a TCP dial, ADC_PROBE_NET), gw (the gateway socket, ADC_PROBE_GATEWAY) and out (a write of ../../canary-hostile-test-escape). Run by host go test with a decoy $HOME/.config/adc, a decoy env name, its own decoy unix sockets and a loopback TCP port, it fails naming all five probes and creates exactly the case's canary_paths; in the gate every probe is denied or empty, so the gate stays empty/completed_clean.
